Powersets.name: Necromancy
Powersets.desc: Raise the dead to fight for you. Your undead minions will overwhelm your foes.

powers.name: Zombie Horde
powers.desc: Summon 1 to 3 Zombies depending on your level.

powers.name: Enchant Undead
powers.desc: Equip your undead with weapons and armor.

powers.name: Grave Knight
powers.desc: Summon 1 or 2 Grave Knights depending on your level.

powers.name: Dark Empowerment
powers.desc: Empower your undead with dark magic.
